# sigma_deployment_policy_tenants (Data Source)

Lists tenant organizations available to target with a sigma_deployment_policy_tenant, for looking up tenant_organization_id by slug or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_deployment_policy_tenants" "all" {}

output "acme_tenant_id" {
  value = [for t in data.sigma_deployment_policy_tenants.all.tenants : t.tenant_organization_id if t.tenant_organization_slug == "acme"][0]
}
```
